name: Creator Outreach

creator_name.description: Verified public first name, or user-approved channel greeting; never invent a personal name.

channel_name.description: Actual channel name; preserve the approved fixed PR wording outside variables.

reference_work.description: Actual referenced game or work supported by saved creator evidence; do not invent coverage.

specific_observation.description: One or two complete, naturally phrased sentences, including punctuation, connecting the referenced game/work to the confirmed target game through evidenced gameplay, style, themes or audience fit. No fixed 'I liked how you' opening; distinguish inference from facts and do not invent viewing claims.

game_name.description: Confirmed target game title, not the creator's reference game.

game_tagline.description: Short factual phrase for the subject; no final punctuation or line breaks.

game_summary.description: Complete concise paragraph with punctuation: confirmed genre, style, premise. Do not copy facts from another game.

gameplay_summary.description: Complete concise paragraph with punctuation: actual gameplay and game loop; avoid repeating game_summary.

availability_statement.description: Complete factual sentence with punctuation explaining current availability or where to learn more; never invent demo, release or access.

game_url.description: Verified public link for this target game or its available demo.

subject: Internal Test — Thought you might enjoy ${game_name} — ${game_tagline}
